THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
ROMANTIC GEOMETRY
043
58
Beret &
Pearls
A polished beauty portrait
against a light gray gradient: a
black wool beret with a gold
medallion, black hair in a low
braided bun with loose
face-framing strands, winged liner,
glossy rose lips, layered pearl and
gold-chain necklaces and a black
square-neck top.
